selected_evidence.summary: Runtime, static, and /etc/hostname values all equal os-lab.infra.test, including after reboot.
/etc/hosts maps the FQDN to 127.0.1.1, and getent resolution succeeded before and after reboot.

Healthy task baseline used boot ID 8e0ddb92-5f82-4d03-942e-362c27d766cd; the reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID 1faf62df-7632-4ee2-9580-2212f731980c; hostname, resolver data, and multi-user target recovered.
ssh.service was already failed before changes and remains failed because the baseline lacks SSH host keys; this did not affect the managed command path or required hostname functionality.

commands.command:
set -eu
expected=os-lab.infra.test
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'kernel_hostname='; hostname
printf 'static_hostname='; hostnamectl --static
printf 'persistent_hostname='; cat /etc/hostname
printf '%s\n' 'local_resolution:'
getent ahostsv4 "$expected"
test "$(hostname)" = "$expected"
test "$(hostnamectl --static)" = "$expected"
test "$(cat /etc/hostname)" = "$expected"
getent ahostsv4 "$expected" | awk '$1 == "127.0.1.1" { found=1 } END { exit !found }'
printf 'multi_user_target='; systemctl is-active multi-user.target
printf '%s\n' 'baseline_assertions=PASS'
